passive.name: Salvation
passive.description: Soraka runs faster towards nearby low health allies.

spells.name: Starcall
spells.description: Soraka calls down a star, dealing magic damage and Slowing by % for seconds. Hitting an enemy champion grants Soraka Rejuvenation, which restores Health over seconds and grants % Move Speed decaying over the same duration.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Astral Infusion
spells.description: Soraka restores Health to another allied champion. If Soraka is affected by Rejuvenation, the Health cost will be reduced by %, and the target will gain Rejuvenation for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Equinox
spells.description: Soraka creates a starfield that deals magic damage to champions. The field lingers for seconds, Silencing enemies inside. When the zone disappears, champions inside the zone are Rooted for second(s) and take magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Wish
spells.description: Soraka calls upon divine powers, restoring Health to all allied champions, regardless of distance. Healing is increased to on targets below 40% Health.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.
